Higgsfield pricing explained

Edited by Emmanuel Gonzalez

Some links on this page are affiliate links. Affiliate disclosure.

Higgsfield’s current individual and business plan prices are taken from the official pricing page, re-read Nov 24, 2026, 7:25 PM ET (4:25 PM PT). Higgsfield's Black Friday sale is live on its pricing page until Nov 25, 2026, 7:00 PM ET (4:00 PM PT): Plus annual $30/mo and Ultra 3K annual $45/mo, billed yearly. The lowest Higgsfield plan rate already in this catalog is $0.0113/s (Wan 3.0, 480p), assuming every paid credit is used. Unlimited bonuses apply only on higgsfield.ai. Affiliate links never change this price order.

Last checked 2026-11-24.

Related: Higgsfield Black Friday 2026: what you save per second · Is Higgsfield worth it? · Unlimited Seedance 2.5 plans compared · Kling AI pricing and credits · credit calculator.

Key takeaways

  • Lowest Higgsfield plan rate we track. $0.0113/s on Ultra annual 3K for Wan 3.0 (480p, not stated), checked Nov 24, 2026.
  • Individual list & current annual plans. Starter $19/mo (270 credits); Plus $59/mo monthly ($30/mo annual, 1,200 credits); Ultra 3K $129/mo monthly ($45/mo annual, 3,000 credits).
  • Black Friday sale status. Higgsfield's Black Friday sale is live on its pricing page until Nov 25, 2026, 7:00 PM ET (4:00 PM PT): Plus annual $30/mo and Ultra 3K annual $45/mo, billed yearly.
  • Unlimited bonuses. Apply only on higgsfield.ai (never MCP/CLI, Canvas, or Supercomputer) and only while the paid plan stays active.

    What does every Higgsfield plan cost?

    On the official pricing page, re-read Nov 24, 2026, 7:25 PM ET (4:25 PM PT), individual monthly list prices are Starter $19/mo (monthly or annual, same price, 270 credits), Plus $59/mo (1,200 credits), and Ultra 3K $129/mo, Ultra 6K $250/mo, and Ultra 9K $375/mo (3,000 / 6,000 / 9,000 credits). Higgsfield's Black Friday sale is live on its pricing page until Nov 25, 2026, 7:00 PM ET (4:00 PM PT): Plus annual $30/mo and Ultra 3K annual $45/mo, billed yearly. Annual Ultra 6K is $80/mo and Ultra 9K is $115/mo, billed yearly (lists $258 and $387). First month on monthly billing, then renewal at list: Plus $40 then $59; Ultra 3K $75 then $129; Ultra 6K $140 then $250; Ultra 9K $199 then $375. The visible banner is a countdown only, and vendors sometimes extend sales. The 11.11 sale ended at Nov 14, 2026, 7:00 PM ET (4:00 PM PT). Checkout totals are unknown (VAT and local taxes are calculated at checkout). Business, shown per seat: Team annual $45/seat/mo billed yearly (list $79, 1,000 credits/seat); Team monthly $55/seat (list $79); Scale annual $80/seat/mo billed yearly (list $215, 2,500 credits/seat); Scale monthly $119.99/seat/mo (list $215). Enterprise is custom. Prices exclude VAT and local taxes. Sources: higgsfield.ai/pricing (Individual Annual / Monthly and Business tabs, re-read Nov 24, 2026), the public plans API that page loads, and How do Higgsfield plans work?.

    What do credits buy for the models we track?

    The pricing-page compare table states a credits-per-clip figure for each listed model and resolution. Wan 3.0 is 3.75 / 7.5 / 15 credits per 5-second clip at 480p / 720p / 1080p; Wan 3.0 Prime is 6.25 / 13.75 / 27.5 (re-read Nov 24, after Higgsfield cut Wan credits on Nov 22). Those figures have no tilde. Kling 3.0 is labeled “~7 / ~8 / ~30 credits/5s” at 720p / 1080p / 4K (the same table’s annual video counts divide to 7.5 and about 8.75 at 720p and 1080p; the catalog keeps those as estimates). Seedance 2.5 is 35 credits/5s at 720p and 80 credits/5s at 1080p. Google Veo 3.1 is “~16 credits/4s” (Fast) and “~40 credits/4s” (standard) at 720p and at 1080p. Minimax Hailuo 2.3 is “~6 / ~10 credits/6s” at 768p / 1080p, or “~4 / ~7” for Fast. Grok Video is “~7 credits/5s” and Grok Video Edit is “~10 credits/5s,” with no resolution on the label. Gemini Omni Flash and Runway Gen-4 do not appear on that compare table or on the API pricing index checked Nov 13, 2026, so this guide does not invent a Higgsfield credit cost for them. A 10-second clip is shown only where the official unit is 5 seconds and the catalog already prices by the second; Veo’s official unit is 4 seconds and Hailuo’s is 6 seconds, and a 10-second length is not published for those. Source: the Video category of the compare table on higgsfield.ai/pricing, from the compare API that page loads, checked Nov 13, 2026.

    How do Higgsfield credits work?

    Official help, re-read Nov 18, 2026, says credits are what Higgsfield charges for image and video generations. The cost depends on the model, resolution, and duration, and is shown on the Generate button before you confirm. Plan credits reset and do not roll over: on monthly plans at each paid renewal, and on annual plans every 30 days. Credit Pack, Auto-Refill, and Boost credits are one-time balances that expire 90 days from purchase. Promo credits expire on the date shown when they are issued. Plan credits are spent first; then any remaining credits are spent by the earliest expiry date. Credits per clip for the models we track are in the compare-table section on this page, not in the help article. Sources: How do credits work?, Do my top-up credits expire, and what happens if I cancel?, and How do Credit Packs work?, re-read Nov 18, 2026. Current sale prices for paid plans are in the plan table above and on the live deals page; they are not repeated here.

    The catalog already converts those official (or official-estimate) credit figures into $/s for Starter, Plus, and Ultra 3K in the dated Higgsfield per-second table at the top of this guide, using each plan’s dollars and credits and assuming every paid credit is used.

    Seedance 2.5 and Grok are on the official compare table but do not have Higgsfield plan rows in the catalog (Seedance 2.5 on plans was left out of earlier guides for the same reason; Grok Video has no stated resolution). The next table applies the same credit-use math to the official credits and to the Starter / Plus / Ultra 3K catalog plan prices, plus Ultra 6K annual and Ultra 9K annual. Ultra 9K annual has the lowest credit price of those plans. These derived figures are not catalog rows.

    When is pay-as-you-go elsewhere cheaper?

    For a short clip billed from plan credits, the cheapest Higgsfield credit rate on the current annual prices is Ultra 9K annual at $115/mo billed yearly ÷ 9,000 credits ($0.01278/credit), if every paid credit is used. Ultra 6K annual at $80/mo billed yearly ÷ 6,000 credits is $0.01333/credit. That still has to beat a published pay-as-you-go rate at the same model and resolution. Where this catalog already has a Higgsfield plan $/s next to a cheaper verified API elsewhere, the table below names that API. Higgsfield API list prices are a separate pay-as-you-go route (for example Wan 3.0 Prime at $0.051 / $0.105 / $0.21 per second, and “from” $0.118/s for Seedance 2.5 and “from” $0.071/s for Kling 3.0, with the cheapest mode’s resolution not stated on the list). Unlimited windows are not treated as $0/s.

    What does the Higgsfield API cost?

    Higgsfield's official API is billed pay-as-you-go, separately from plan credits. In our catalog, the cheapest Higgsfield API row is $0.0375/s for wan-3-0 (Text to video, 480p), checked Nov 24, 2026. Other catalog API rows on this page include Wan 3.0 Prime, Wan 3.0, Kling 3.0, and Seedance 2.5 list rates from the official API pricing page. Those API list prices are not plan-sale prices.     How do Unlimited bonuses work, and where do they apply?

    Higgsfield’s help article and the pricing-page footer both say Unlimited models and free generations are accessible only on higgsfield.ai, not on MCP/CLI, Canvas, or Supercomputer. Generations outside higgsfield.ai deduct credits. The toggle in the generation panel has to be on, or the run uses credits. Unlimited runs in the standard queue; credit runs are in the priority queue, and Unlimited speed may be adjusted in high traffic. Access is a one-time period that only works while the paid plan stays active. On the Nov 16 Individual Annual Plus and Ultra cards, the visible unlimited line is “Unlimited models for 7 days”; when that window starts or ends is unknown. The earlier 11.11 check on 2026-11-13 had listed annual Plus at 14 days of unlimited Seedance 2.5 at 30s and 720p, and annual Ultra 3K/6K/9K at 14 days at 30s and 1080p; those 14-day details were not reconfirmed on Nov 16. The Nov 13 monthly cards listed Plus at 7 days at 20s and 480p and Ultra 3K at 14 days at 20s and 720p. Starter lists no Seedance 2.5 unlimited window. Scale annual, after business verification, includes 30 days of unlimited Seedance 2.5 at 25s and 720p; Scale monthly includes 7 days at the same cap. Team’s unlimited video window is Seedance 2.0 (15s, 720p), not Seedance 2.5: 14 days on annual, 7 days on monthly, also after business verification. The page does not say when those day counts start. Sources: What are Unlimited models?, the pricing-page footer and plan cards on higgsfield.ai/pricing, re-read Nov 24, 2026, and the ended 11.11 sale record checked Nov 13, 2026.

    The same help article describes a longer “365 Unlimited” style of access on mid and top plans: generations on listed models do not deduct credits for a stated period, only while the paid plan stays active, and only on higgsfield.ai. Plus and Ultra cards also say “5 other unlimited models” without naming them on the card. This guide does not invent those five names or treat any Unlimited window as $0/s.

    How promo prices work says a promo price applies to the first payment or the period stated in the offer, and that the plan then renews at the standard price. Monthly Plus and Ultra first-month cards already print the renewal list price. The annual sale cards do not print a post-sale price, so what annual billing costs after the sale ends (Nov 25, 2026, 7:00 PM ET (4:00 PM PT)) is not confirmed. The 11.11 sale already ended at Nov 14, 2026, 7:00 PM ET (4:00 PM PT).

    What is Higgsfield's refund policy?

    Official help, re-read Nov 18, 2026, says refunds are for initial purchases only, within 7 days or as permitted by the law in your jurisdiction, and only if no credits have been used. Renewals are not refundable. Credit Packs and Auto-Refill charges can be refunded on the same 7-day, unused-credit conditions. Offers that unlock access or features rather than credits are not refundable once that access is granted. Using free generations or Unlimited model generations does not count as credit use. A service fee of up to 6% is deducted, and if a refund is approved the plan is cancelled immediately, with funds returning to the original payment method in 5–10 business days. Cancelling a plan does not, by itself, issue a refund. Request a refund through Higgsfield's contact form with your account email, purchase date, amount, and a short reason. Sources: How do I request a refund? and How do I cancel my subscription?, re-read Nov 18, 2026. The full terms are also in Section 9.3 of Higgsfield's Terms of Use, linked from that help article. Consumers in the EEA or UK may have a 14-day withdrawal window, per the same refund article.

    How do I cancel a Higgsfield plan?

    Official help, re-read Nov 18, 2026, says cancelling turns off auto-renewal. The plan stays active until the end of the current paid period, then the account moves to the free plan. Cancel from Manage Account, then the plan section, then Plan Settings, then Manage the plan, then Show, then Cancel the plan. This does not delete your account or your generations, and it does not automatically refund the current period. Plan credits remain usable until the paid period ends, then they expire. Credit Pack, Auto-Refill, promo, and Boost credits stay available on the free plan until their own expiry dates, and can be spent on the models the free plan includes. The official menu labels are “Subscription,” “Manage Subscription,” and “Cancel Subscription.” Source: How do I cancel my subscription?, re-read Nov 18, 2026. Team, Scale, and Enterprise plans are cancelled by the workspace Owner from Organization settings, per that article. Canceling and refunding are separate actions.

    Is Higgsfield free?

    Yes, there is a free plan. Official help, re-read Nov 18, 2026, says every new account starts on it at no cost. It opens a limited set of models, runs one generation at a time, does not include monthly credits or Unlimited models, and generations can carry a visible Higgsfield watermark. Models on the free plan still deduct credits, so you need credits or free generations already on the account to generate. Credit Packs cannot be bought on the free plan. Current plan prices and which models sit in the Free column are on Higgsfield's pricing page. A short dedicated page on whether Higgsfield is free is planned. Source: What does the Higgsfield free plan include?, re-read Nov 18, 2026.

    How do we calculate this?

    Each dollar figure is a current price row, with the vendor page and the date that page was checked. A published rate is a dollars-per-second figure on that page, or an API credit count times the credit price the page states. A credit-plan figure is plan price ÷ credits × credits per clip ÷ seconds, and it assumes every credit you pay for is used. When the vendor marks that count with "~", "roughly", or "estimated", the row is labelled estimated from credit plan and is not a list price. A promo shows its end date when the vendor gave one. The full method is on the about page.
